cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your medal the star of the charity auction, if you'll let me put it up for sale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your name goes beside it, with the story of the race. You can choose every word; I'll make sure nobody mistakes it for just another lot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display? I want people to know I won, but I want it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can open the display yourself. Then, if you're willing, present it to the buyer. I'll keep your name in the programme after it's gone; would that let you part with it?

reason: Make A confident auction promotion depend on B chosen story and explicit willingness, using B recognition request to make permanent surrender emotionally more acceptable.
